answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1250 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the dawn. The pulse index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an hostile operator to the back of the quartz queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. The deposit is 25 dollars a seat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
